description: This file defines the ProcStatus struct and associated functions to read and parse process status information from /proc/[pid]/status in Linux systems, including memory usage, context switches, and namespace IDs.

classes.name: ProcStatus
classes.description: Struct holding detailed process status information parsed from /proc/[pid]/status.

methods.name: Proc.NewStatus
methods.description: Reads and parses the process status information from the filesystem.

methods.name: ProcStatus.fillStatus
methods.description: Populates the ProcStatus fields based on key-value pairs from the status file.

methods.name: ProcStatus.TotalCtxtSwitches
methods.description: Returns the total number of context switches (voluntary + involuntary).
